answer.book: Casaubon's Greek-Latin edition of Aristotle's Opera (Geneva, Lemarius, 1590), a multi-work volume in which each work is divided into books and chapters; this part of the sheet covers the zoological works (Historia animalium, De partibus, De generatione), the Mechanica, De coloribus, De lineis insecabilibus with its commentary, Physiognomonica, the Xenophanes, Zeno and Gorgias fragments, and De ventorum positione.
